name: Pigments and Materials
intro: What paintings are made of: the pigments painters used and where they came from, the binders that turn powder into paint, the panels, canvases and grounds underneath, and how all of it changes over time. Concept pages explain one idea with an original diagram; example pages show it in a public-domain work.
